## Description

Context: what we decided and why. What happens inside an approved organisation is its own responsibility. Medvya does not check doctors; the owner enters the licence and attests it, accepting liability in the terms (MDV-P1-067). The owner accepted that there is no independent check, including for controlled drugs.
What to build. The licence record (number, authority, expiry) is required and entered by the owner for each doctor, and for the owner-doctor in the wizard, with an attestation checkbox. The audit (append-only) stores the owner, time and values. Remove the Verified, Pending and Rejected states, the verification step in the Add doctor wizard, ILicenceReview and the "Verification pending" notice; recording, signing and prescribing no longer depend on VerifiedAt. The doctor list shows "Attested by {owner} on {date}". The licence number and authority are kept on DoctorLicence for the prescription print to read; printing them is a criterion of MDV-P2-017, which owns the print. Expiry reminders stay; an expired licence warns the owner and doctor and asks the owner to re-attest (does not block; open question).
Touched: Medvya.Tenancy.Infrastructure/Doctors.cs, Application/IDoctors.cs, Domain/Practice.cs (DoctorLicence, LicenceStatus, LicenceRules), PracticeProvisioning.cs, Host.Api/Auth/SessionControl.cs, web/clinic doctors and onboarding features, App.tsx LicenceNotice, the prescription print, i18n, ERD.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given an owner adds a doctor, when licence number, authority, expiry or the attestation is missing, then the doctor cannot be added.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given a doctor was added, when anyone views the doctor list, then it shows who attested and when, and the audit holds the values.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an approved organisation, when a doctor with an attested licence records, signs or prescribes, then it is allowed with no Medvya check.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given a licence nears or passes expiry, when the reminder runs, then the owner is told to re-attest and signing is not blocked.
- [ ] **AC5.** The licence gate tests are replaced by attestation tests and no endpoint still reads VerifiedAt.

## Test notes

- Unit: attestation validation, expiry rules per country.
- Integration on real PostgreSQL: add doctor with and without attestation, audit content, signing allowed.
- Playwright: J1 steps 1 and 7 (sign) without any verification step.
- Security: server-side authorisation, audit append-only, ponytail-review.
- Browser: English and Arabic, axe clean.
